name: gmust-plugins
description: Plugins for setting up agent-friendly repositories.

plugins.name: setup-agentic-workflow
plugins.description: Four skills (setup orchestrator, agent-entrypoints, quality-gate, handoff) plus context-persistence hooks: living docs/HANDOFF.yaml re-injected after compaction; REVIEW.md and PR template when the team uses AI review.

plugins.name: dual-review
plugins.description: Two-reviewer consensus code review: risk-based depth, a security pass on risky changes, optional verified fixes. Recommended by setup-agentic-workflow, installed separately.
